radiusSource: Radius 1.597 Jupiter radii from Hooton et al. 2022 (2022A&A...658A..75H), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2022A&A...658A..75H/abstract): 114,172.7 km at 71,492 km per Jupiter radius. shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius in the shared neutral gray. No image, colour, map or oblateness of MASCARA-1 b is measured; only its size, mass and orbit are.
